purpose: Gate the pinned HyperQwen TP=2 service before any Tool-Eval A/B run.
passCriteria: the first tool call is read_file with the exact source.txt path and a call id
after the actual read result, the next tool call is write_file with exact result.txt path and a call id
written bytes exactly match the fixture bytes
the model returns a non-empty final response without another tool call
the runner records a receipt without secrets and removes the temporary workspace
the wrapper stops the candidate Compose service on exit
failurePolicy: Do not run Tool-Eval; retain the failure receipt and diagnose before another preregistered attempt.
limitations: This is a model-server tool-protocol canary, not an end-to-end LlamaCode integration test.
A passing canary is not evidence of model superiority, adoption readiness, or long-context parity.
